_comment: Known-good content hashes of the PlatformIO packages the firmware is built with (HW-3 of docs/REVIEW_PLAN_2026-11-08.md).
tools/build_release.py hashes the installed packages (python tools/build_release.py --package-hashes prints them): a mismatch
stops the release, an entry whose sha256 is null only warns. The hash covers every file's path and contents except
PlatformIO's .piopm, __pycache__ and *.pyc. Fill in the sha256 of a PRISTINE install (e.g. delete the package folder and let
pio run reinstall it from the URL in platformio.ini) - NOT of a locally modified copy.
